mapper.sql: SELECT c.id, c.code, c.name, c.teacher_id, u.username AS teacher_username, u.real_name AS teacher_real_name, c.status, c.archived_at, c.created_at, COALESCE(nc.cnt, 0) AS node_count, COALESCE(sc.cnt, 0) AS student_count, COALESCE(cc.cnt, 0) AS clazz_count FROM course c LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = c.teacher_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT course_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM kg_node WHERE archived_at IS NULL OR archived_by_course = 1 GROUP BY course_id) nc ON nc.course_id = c.id LEFT JOIN (SELECT course_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM student_course GROUP BY course_id) sc ON sc.course_id = c.id LEFT JOIN (SELECT course_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM clazz_course GROUP BY course_id) cc ON cc.course_id = c.id

where.if: AND (c.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%') OR c.code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%'))
